Furthermore, you should know that the bearers of the trust of divine Unity, who appear in the earthly realms with a new decree and a wondrous Cause, are regarded as one soul and one essence, since these birds of the everlasting Throne descend from the heaven of the divine will and all arise to uphold God’s irrevocable Cause. For all drink from the cup of divine love and are nourished by the fruits of the tree of oneness. Two stations are assigned to these Manifestations of God. One is the station of pure abstraction and the essence of singleness. In this station, there is no harm in calling and describing them all by one name and designation, as He says, “We make no distinction between any of His messengers.” For they all summon people to divine unity and bring glad tidings of the river of limitless grace and bounty. All are invested with the robes of prophethood and honored with the mantle of glory. Thus the Point of the Qur’an says, “As for the Prophets, I am they.” Likewise, He says, “I am the first Adam, Noah, Moses, and Jesus.” The Countenance of ‘Alí has also expressed this same meaning. Utterances such as these, which indicate the oneness of those embodiments of abstraction, have issued from the channels of eternal utterance and the treasuries of the pearls of knowledge, and have been recorded in the books. These Countenances are the seats of divine decree and the dawning places of the Cause, and the Cause is sanctified above the veils of multiplicity and the contingencies of plurality. Thus He says, “Our Cause is but one.” Since the Cause is one, its Manifestations are necessarily also one. Likewise, the Imams of religion, those lamps of certitude, have said, “Our first is Muḥammad, our last is Muḥammad, and our middle is Muḥammad.”
:::

### 163

::: {.original lang="fa"}
باری معلوم و محقّق آن جناب بوده که جمیع انبیا هیاکل امر اللّه هستند که در قمایص مختلفه ظاهر شدند و اگر بنظر لطیف ملاحظه فرمائی همه را در یک رضوان ساکن بینی و در یک هوا طائر و بر یک بساط جالس و بر یک کلام ناطق و بر یک امر آمر اینست اتّحاد آن جواهر وجود و شموس غیر محدود و معدود پس اگر یکی از این مظاهر قدسیّه بفرماید من رجوع کلّ انبیا هستم صادقست و همچنین ثابت است در هر ظهور بعد صدق رجوع ظهور قبل و چون رجوع انبیا موافق و مطابق آیات و اخبار ثابت شد رجوع اولیا هم ثابت و محقّق است و این رجوع اظهر از آن است که بدلیل و برهان محتاج شود مثلاً ملاحظه فرمائید از جملهٔ انبیا نوح بود که چون مبعوث بنبوّت شد و بقیام الهی بر امر قیام فرمود هر نفسی که باو مؤمن و بامر او مذعن شد او فی‌الحقیقه بحیات جدیده مشرّف شد و در حقّ او صادق میآمد حیات بدیع و روح جدید زیرا که او قبل از ایمان بخدا و اذعان بمظهر نفس او کمال علایق را باموال و اسباب متعلّقهٔ بدنیا از قبیل زن و فرزند و اطعمه و اشربه و امثال ذلک داشته بقسمی که اوقات لیل و نهار را مصروف بر اخذ زخارف و اسباب تعیّش داشته و همّت در تحصیل اشیای فانیه گماشته و از این مراتب گذشته قبل از ورود در لجّهٔ ایمان بحدودات آباء و اجداد و اتّباع آداب و شرایع ایشان چنان راسخ و محکم بود که اگر حکم بقتل او میشد شاید رضا میداد و راضی بر تغییر حرفی از امور تقلیدیّه که در میان قوم بود نمیشد چنانچه همهٔ قوم نداء انّا وجدنا آبائنا علی امّة و انّا علی آثارهم مقتدون برآوردند
:::

::: transliteration
Bārī maʿlūm va muḥaqqaq-i ān janāb būdih kih jamīʿ-i anbiyā hayākil-i Amruʾllāh hastand kih dar qamāyiṣ-i mukhtalifih ẓāhir shudand, va agar bi-naẓar-i laṭīf mulāḥiẓih farmāʾī hamih rā dar yik Riḍvān sākin bīnī va dar yik havā ṭāʾir va bar yik bisāṭ jālis va bar yik kalām nāṭiq va bar yik amr āmir. Īnast ittiḥād-i ān javāhir-i vujūd va shumūs-i ghayr-i maḥdūd va maʿdūd. Pas agar yikī az īn maẓāhir-i qudsiyyih bifarmāyad man rujūʿ-i kull-i anbiyā hastam ṣādiqast. Va hamchunīn thābit ast dar har ẓuhūr-i baʿd ṣidq-i rujūʿ-i ẓuhūr-i qabl. Va chūn rujūʿ-i anbiyā muvāfiq va muṭābiq-i āyāt va akhbār thābit shud rujūʿ-i awliyā ham thābit va muḥaqqaq ast. Va īn rujūʿ aẓhar az ān ast kih bi-dalīl va burhān muḥtāj shavad. Mathalan mulāḥiẓih farmāʾīd az jumlih-yi anbiyā Nūḥ būd kih chūn mabʿūth bi-nubuwwat shud va bi-qiyām-i Ilāhī bar amr qiyām farmūd har nafsī kih bi-ū muʾmin va bi-amr-i ū mudhʿin shud ū fī al-ḥaqīqih bi-ḥayāt-i jadīdih musharraf shud va dar ḥaqq-i ū ṣādiq mīāmad ḥayāt-i badīʿ va rūḥ-i jadīd. Zīrā kih ū qabl az īmān bi-Khudā va idhʿān bi-maẓhar-i nafs-i ū kamāl-i ʿalāyiq rā bi-amvāl va asbāb-i mutaʿalliqih bi-dunyā az qabīl-i zan va farzand va aṭʿimih va ashribih va amthāl-i dhālik dāshtih, bi-qismī kih awqāt-i layl va nahār rā maṣrūf bar akhdh-i zakhārif va asbāb-i taʿayyush dāshtih va himmat dar taḥṣīl-i ashyā-yi fāniyih gumāshtih. Va az īn marātib gudhashtih qabl az vurūd dar lujjih-yi īmān bi-ḥudūdāt-i ābā va ajdād va ittibāʿ-i ādāb va sharāyiʿ-i īshān chunān rāsikh va muḥkam būd kih agar ḥukm bi-qatl-i ū mīshud shāyad riḍā mīdād va rāḍī bar taghyīr-i ḥarfī az umūr-i taqlīdiyyih kih dar miyān-i qawm būd namīshud. Chunānchih hamih-yi qawm nidā-yi innā wajadnā ābāʾanā ʿalā ummatin wa-innā ʿalā āthārihim muqtadūn bar-āvur dand.
:::

::: translation
In short, you should know and be certain that all the Prophets are the temples of the Cause of God, who have appeared in different garments. If you look with discerning vision, you will see them all dwelling in one Paradise, flying in one sky, seated upon one carpet, speaking one word, and enjoining one Cause. Such is the unity of those Essences of being, those Suns beyond limitation and number. Thus, if one of these holy Manifestations should say, “I am the return of all the Prophets,” He speaks the truth. Likewise, in every subsequent revelation, the truth of the return of the previous revelation is established. Since the return of the Prophets has been established in accordance with the verses and traditions, the return of their chosen ones is also established and certain. This return is too evident to need proof or demonstration. Consider, for example, Noah, who was among the Prophets. When He was raised to prophethood and arose with divine resolve to uphold the Cause, every soul who believed in Him and acknowledged His Cause was truly honored with a new life, and a wondrous life and a new spirit could truly be attributed to that person. For before believing in God and acknowledging the Manifestation of His own Self, that person had been utterly attached to possessions and worldly concerns, such as wife and children, food and drink, and the like, to such a degree that he spent his days and nights acquiring worldly ornaments and the means of livelihood, and devoted his efforts to obtaining perishable things. Beyond all this, before entering the ocean of faith, he was so firmly and steadfastly committed to the precepts of his forefathers and to following their customs and religious laws that he might have consented to being put to death, but would not have consented to changing a single letter of the inherited practices current among his people. Thus all the people raised the cry, “We found our fathers following a way, and we follow in their footsteps.”
:::

### 164

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و همین گروه با همهٔ این حجبات محدوده و حدودات مذکوره بمجرّد اینکه صهبای ایمان را از کأس ایقان از ایادی مظاهر سبحان مینوشیدند بالمرّه تقلیب میشدند بقسمی که از زن و فرزند و اموال و اثقال و جان و ایمان بلکه از کلّ ماسوی میگذشتند و بقسمی غلبات شوق الهی و جذبات ذوق صمدانی ایشان را اخذ مینمود که دنیا را و آنچه در آن هست بپر کاهی ندانسته آیا حکم خلق جدید و رجوع در اینها نمیشود و همچنین ملاحظه شد که این نفوس قبل از فوز بعنایت بدیع جدید الهی جان خود را بصد‌هزار حیله و تدبیر از موارد هلاکت حفظ مینمودند بقسمی که از خاری احتراز میجستند و از روباهی فی‌المثل فرار مینمودند و بعد از شرف بفوز اکبر و عنایت عظمی صدهزار جان رایگان انفاق میفرمودند بلکه نفوس مقدّسشان از قفس تن بیزار و یک نفر از این جنود در مقابل گروهی مقاتله مینمود مع‌ذلک چگونه میشود که اگر این نفوس همان نفوس قبل باشند اینگونه امورات که مخالف عادات بشریّه و منافی هوای جسمانیّه است از ایشان ظاهر شود
:::

::: transliteration
Va hamīn gurūh bā hamih-yi īn ḥujubāt-i maḥdūdih va ḥudūdāt-i madhkūrih bi-mujarrad-i īnkih ṣahbā-yi īmān rā az kaʾs-i īqān az ayādī-yi maẓāhir-i Subḥān mīnūshīdand bi-l-marrih taqlīb mīshudand, bi-qismī kih az zan va farzand va amvāl va athqāl va jān va īmān balkih az kull-i mā-sivā mīgudhashtand. Va bi-qismī ghalabāt-i shawq-i Ilāhī va jadhabāt-i dhawq-i Ṣamadānī īshān rā akhdh mīnamūd kih dunyā rā va ānchih dar ān hast bi-par-i kāhī nadānistih. Āyā ḥukm-i khalq-i jadīd va rujūʿ dar īnhā namīshavad? Va hamchunīn mulāḥiẓih shud kih īn nufūs qabl az fawz bi-ʿināyat-i badīʿ-i jadīd-i Ilāhī jān-i khud rā bi-ṣad-hizār ḥīlih va tadbīr az mavārid-i halākat ḥifẓ mīnamūdand, bi-qismī kih az khārī iḥtirāz mījustand va az rūbāhī fī al-mathal farār mīnamūdand. Va baʿd az sharaf bi-fawz-i akbar va ʿināyat-i ʿuẓmā ṣad-hizār jān rāygān infāq mīfarmūdand. Balkih nufūs-i muqaddasishān az qafas-i tan bīzār va yik nafar az īn junūd dar muqābil-i gurūhī muqātilih mīnamūd. Maʿa-dhālik chigūnih mīshavad kih agar īn nufūs hamān nufūs-i qabl bāshand īngūnih umūrāt kih mukhālif-i ʿādāt-i bashariyyih va munāfī-yi havā-yi jismāniyyih ast az īshān ẓāhir shavad?
:::

::: translation
Yet these very people, despite all these restricting veils and the limitations already mentioned, were completely transformed as soon as they drank the wine of faith from the cup of certitude at the hands of the Manifestations of the All-Glorious. They would relinquish wife and children, possessions and belongings, life and faith—indeed, everything besides God. The surging power of divine longing and the compelling attractions of heavenly delight so seized them that they considered the world and everything in it worth less than a wisp of straw. Does not the designation of a new creation and return apply to them? Likewise, it was observed that before attaining God’s wondrous new favor, these souls would protect their lives from mortal danger by a hundred thousand stratagems and devices, to such a degree that they would avoid a thorn and flee, for example, from a fox. But after being honored with the greatest attainment and the supreme favor, they would freely give away a hundred thousand lives. Indeed, their sanctified souls were weary of the cage of the body, and a single soldier among them would fight against a multitude. Nevertheless, if these souls were the same as before, how could such deeds, contrary to human habits and incompatible with bodily desires, proceed from them?
:::

### 165

::: {.original lang="fa"}
باری این مطلب واضحست که بدون تغییر و تبدیل الهی محالست این قسم آثار و افعال که بهیچوجه شباهت بآثار و افعال قبل ندارد از ایشان ظاهر شود و در عرصهٔ کون بوجود آید چنانچه اضطرابشان باطمینان تبدیل میشد و ظنّ بیقین تغییر مییافت و خوف بجرئت مبادله میگشت اینست شأن اکسیر الهی که در یک حین عباد را تقلیب میفرماید
:::

::: transliteration
Bārī īn maṭlab vāżeḥ ast ke bedūn-e taghyīr va tabdīl-e ilāhī moḥāl ast īn qesm āthār va afʿāl ke be-hīch vajh shabāhat be-āthār va afʿāl-e qabl nadārad az īshān ẓāher shavad va dar ʿarṣe-ye kawn be-vojūd āyad. Chenānche eżṭerābeshān be-eṭmīnān tabdīl mīshod va ẓann be-yaqīn taghyīr mīyāft va khawf be-jorʾat mobādele mīgasht. Īn ast shaʾn-e eksīr-e ilāhī ke dar yek ḥīn ʿebād rā taqlīb mīfarmāyad.
:::

::: translation
In short, it is clear that without divine transformation and change, it would be impossible for such deeds and actions, bearing no resemblance whatsoever to their former deeds and actions, to proceed from them and come into being in the world of existence. Thus their agitation was transformed into assurance, their doubt into certainty, and their fear into courage. Such is the power of the divine elixir, which transforms people in a single moment.
:::

### 166

::: {.original lang="fa"}
مثلاً در مادّهٔ نحاسی ملاحظه فرمائید که اگر در معدن خود از غلبهٔ یبوست محفوظ بماند در مدّت هفتاد سنه بمقام ذهبی میرسد اگرچه بعضی خود نحاس را ذهب میدانند که بواسطهٔ غلبهٔ یبوست مریض شده و بمقام خود نرسیده
:::

::: transliteration
Mathalan dar mādde-ye noḥāsī molāḥeẓe farmāyīd ke agar dar maʿdan-e khod az ghalabe-ye yobūsat maḥfūẓ bemānad dar moddat-e haftād sane be-maqām-e dhahabī mīrasad. Agarche baʿżī khod-e noḥās rā dhahab mīdānand ke be-vāseṭe-ye ghalabe-ye yobūsat marīż shode va be-maqām-e khod narasīde.
:::

::: translation
Consider, for example, the substance of copper: if it remains in its mine, protected from an excess of dryness, it attains the state of gold within seventy years. Some, however, regard copper itself as gold that has become diseased through an excess of dryness and has not attained its proper state.
:::

### 167

::: {.original lang="fa"}
باری در هر حال اکسیر کامل مادّهٔ نحاسی را در آنی بمقام ذهبی میرساند و منازل هفتادساله را بآنی طیّ نماید آیا آن ذهب را بعد میتوان گفت که نحاسست و یا بعالم ذهبی نرسیده و حال آنکه محک در میان است و صفات ذهبی را از نحاسی معیّن و واضح مینماید
:::

::: transliteration
Bārī dar har ḥāl eksīr-e kāmel mādde-ye noḥāsī rā dar ānī be-maqām-e dhahabī mīrasānad va manāzel-e haftād-sāle rā be-ānī ṭeyy namāyad. Āyā ān dhahab rā baʿd mītavān goft ke noḥās ast va yā be-ʿālam-e dhahabī narasīde va ḥāl ānke maḥakk dar miyān ast va ṣefāt-e dhahabī rā az noḥāsī moʿayyan va vāżeḥ mīnamāyad?
:::

::: translation
In any case, the perfect elixir brings the substance of copper to the state of gold in an instant, traversing in a moment the stages of seventy years. Can that gold then be called copper, or said not to have attained the state of gold, when the touchstone is at hand and clearly distinguishes the qualities of gold from those of copper?
:::

### 168

::: {.original lang="fa"}
همچنین این نفوس هم از اکسیر الهی در آنی عالم ترابی را طیّ نموده بعوالم قدسی قدم گذارند و بقدمی از مکان محدود بلامکان الهی واصل شوند جهدی باید تا باین اکسیر فائز شوی که در یک آن مغرب جهل را بمشرق علم رساند و ظلمت لیل ظلمانی را بصبح نورانی فائز گرداند و بعید صحرای ظنّ را بچشمهٔ قرب و یقین دلالت کند و هیاکل فانیه را برضوان باقی مشرّف فرماید حال اگر در حقّ این ذهب حکم نحاسی صادق میآید در حقّ این عباد هم حکم عباد قبل از فوز بایمان صادق و محقّق است
:::

::: transliteration
Hamchenīn īn nofūs ham az eksīr-e ilāhī dar ānī ʿālam-e torābī rā ṭeyy namūde be-ʿavālem-e qodsī qadam godhārand va be-qadamī az makān-e maḥdūd be-lāmakān-e ilāhī vāṣel shavand. Jahdī bāyad tā be-īn eksīr fāʾez shavī ke dar yek ān maghreb-e jahl rā be-mashreq-e ʿelm rasānad va ẓolmat-e leyl-e ẓolmānī rā be-ṣobḥ-e nūrānī fāʾez gardānad va baʿīd-e ṣaḥrā-ye ẓann rā be-cheshme-ye qorb va yaqīn delālat konad va hayākel-e fāniye rā be-reżvān-e bāqī mosharraf farmāyad. Ḥāl agar dar ḥaqq-e īn dhahab ḥokm-e noḥāsī ṣādeq mīāyad dar ḥaqq-e īn ʿebād ham ḥokm-e ʿebād-e qabl az fawz be-īmān ṣādeq va moḥaqqaq ast.
:::

::: translation
Likewise, through the divine elixir, these souls traverse the earthly world in an instant and enter the realms of holiness; in a single step they pass from limited space into the divine realm beyond space. An effort is needed for you to attain this elixir, which in a single moment brings the west of ignorance to the east of knowledge, leads the darkness of a gloomy night to a radiant dawn, guides those far away in the wilderness of doubt to the spring of nearness and certainty, and honors mortal forms with admission to the everlasting paradise. Now, if the designation of copper holds true of this gold, then the designation of people as they were before attaining faith also truly and certainly holds true of these servants.
:::

### 169

::: {.original lang="fa"}
ای برادر از این بیانات شافیهٔ کافیهٔ وافیه اسرار خلق جدید و رجوع و بعث بی‌ حجاب و نقاب ظاهر و هویداست انشآءاللّه بتأییدات غیبیّه جامهٔ کهنه را از جسم و جان دور کنی و بخلع جدیدهٔ باقیه مفتخر گردی
:::

::: transliteration
Ey barādar, az īn bayānāt-e shāfiye-ye kāfiye-ye vāfiye asrār-e khalq-e jadīd va rojūʿ va baʿth bī-ḥejāb va neqāb ẓāher va hoveydāst. In shāʾ Allāh be-taʾyīdāt-e gheybiyye jāme-ye kohne rā az jesm va jān dūr konī va be-khelaʿ-e jadīde-ye bāqiye moftakhar gardī.
:::

::: translation
O brother, these healing, sufficient, and comprehensive explanations reveal the mysteries of a new creation, return, and resurrection, without veil or concealment. God willing, through unseen assistance, you will strip the old garment from body and soul and be honored with new and enduring robes.
:::

### 170

::: {.original lang="fa"}
اینست که در هر ظهور بعد انفسی که سبقت یافتند بایمان از کلّ من علی الأرض و شربت زلال معرفت را از جمال احدیّت نوشیدند و باعلی معارج ایمان و ایقان و انقطاع ارتفاع جستند حکم رجوع انفس قبل که در ظهور قبل باین مراتب فائز شده‌اند بر این اصحاب ظهور بعد میشود اسماً و رسماً و فعلاً و قولاً و امراً زیرا آنچه از عباد قبل ظاهر شد از این عباد بعد بعینه ظاهر و هویدا گشت مثلاً اگر شاخسار گلی در مشرق ارض باشد و در مغرب هم از شاخۀ دیگر آن گل ظاهر شود اطلاق گل بر او میشود دیگر در این مقام نظر بحدودات شاخه و هیئت آن نیست بلکه نظر برائحه و عطریست که در هر دو ظاهر است
:::

::: transliteration
Īn ast ke dar har ẓohūr-e baʿd anfosī ke sabqat yāftand be-īmān az koll-e man ʿalā al-arḍ va sharbat-e zolāl-e maʿrefat rā az jamāl-e aḥadiyyat nūshīdand va be-aʿlā maʿārej-e īmān va īqān va enqeṭāʿ ertefāʿ jostand ḥokm-e rojūʿ-e anfos-e qabl ke dar ẓohūr-e qabl be-īn marāteb fāʾez shode-and bar īn aṣḥāb-e ẓohūr-e baʿd mīshavad, isman va rasman va fiʿlan va qawlan va amran. Zīrā ānche az ʿebād-e qabl ẓāher shod az īn ʿebād-e baʿd be-ʿeyne ẓāher va hoveydā gasht. Mathalan agar shākhsār-e golī dar mashreq-e arḍ bāshad va dar maghreb ham az shākhe-ye dīgar ān gol ẓāher shavad eṭlāq-e gol bar ū mīshavad. Dīgar dar īn maqām naẓar be-ḥodūdāt-e shākhe va heyʾat-e ān nīst balke naẓar be-rāʾeḥe va ʿeṭrī-st ke dar har do ẓāher ast.
:::

::: translation
Thus, in every subsequent revelation, those souls who embrace faith before all others on earth, drink the clear draught of recognition from the Beauty of Oneness, and ascend to the highest summits of faith, certitude, and detachment are regarded as the return of those souls who attained these ranks in the preceding revelation. This designation applies to these companions of the later revelation in name, character, deed, word, and purpose. For whatever appeared in the former servants has appeared and become manifest, in its very likeness, in these later servants. For example, if a rosebush stands in the east of the earth, and in the west the same rose appears on another branch, the name of rose applies to it. Here one looks not at the limitations of the branch or its form, but rather at the fragrance and perfume manifest in both.
:::

### 171

::: {.original lang="fa"}
پس نظر را از حدودات ظاهره طاهر و منزّه کن تا همه را بیک اسم و یک رسم و یک ذات و یک حقیقت مشاهده نمائی و اسرار رجوع کلمات را هم در حروفات نازله ملاحظه فرمائی قدری تفکّر در اصحاب عهد نقطهٔ فرقان نما که چگونه از جمیع جهات بشریّه و مشتهیات نفسیّه بنفحات قدسیّهٔ آن حضرت پاک و مقدّس و منقطع گشتند و قبل از همهٔ اهل ارض بشرف لقا که عین لقآء اللّه بود فائز شدند و از کلّ اهل ارض منقطع گشتند چنانچه شنیده‌اید که در مقابل آن مظهر ذی الجلال چگونه جان نثار میفرمودند و حال همان ثبوت و رسوخ و انقطاع را بعینه ملاحظه فرما در اصحاب نقطهٔ بیان راجع شده چنانچه ملاحظه فرموده‌اید که چگونه این اصحاب از بدایع جود ربّ الأرباب علم انقطاع بر رفرف امتناع برافراشتند باری این انوار از یک مصباح ظاهر شده‌اند و این اثمار از یک شجره روئیده‌اند فی‌الحقیقه فرقی ملحوظ نه و تغییری مشهود نه کلّ ذلک من فضل اللّه یؤتیه من یشآء من خلقه انشآءاللّه از ارض نفی احتراز جوئیم و ببحر اثبات درآئیم تا عوالم جمع و فرق و توحید و تفریق و تحدید و تجرید الهی را ببصری که مقدّس از عناصر و اضداد است مشاهده کنیم و باعلی افق قرب و قدس حضرت معانی پرواز نمائیم
:::

::: transliteration
Pas naẓar rā az ḥodūdāt-e ẓāhere ṭāher va monazzah kon tā hame rā be-yek esm va yek rasm va yek dhāt va yek ḥaqīqat moshāhede namāʾī va asrār-e rojūʿ-e kalemāt rā ham dar ḥorūfāt-e nāzele molāḥeẓe farmāʾī. Qadrī tafakkor dar aṣḥāb-e ʿahd-e noqṭe-ye forqān namā ke chegūne az jamīʿ-e jahāt-e bashariyye va moshtahayāt-e nafsiyye be-nafaḥāt-e qodsiyye-ye ān ḥażrat pāk va moqaddas va monqaṭeʿ gashtand va qabl az hame-ye ahl-e arḍ be-sharaf-e leqā ke ʿeyn-e liqāʾ Allāh būd fāʾez shodand va az koll-e ahl-e arḍ monqaṭeʿ gashtand. Chenānche shenīde-īd ke dar moqābel-e ān maẓhar-e dhī al-jalāl chegūne jān nethār mīfarmūdand. Va ḥāl hamān thobūt va rosūkh va enqeṭāʿ rā be-ʿeyne molāḥeẓe farmā dar aṣḥāb-e noqṭe-ye bayān rājeʿ shode, chenānche molāḥeẓe farmūde-īd ke chegūne īn aṣḥāb az badāyeʿ-e jūd-e rabb al-arbāb ʿalam-e enqeṭāʿ bar rafraf-e emtenāʿ bar afrāshtand. Bārī īn anvār az yek meṣbāḥ ẓāher shode-and va īn athmār az yek shajare rūʾīde-and. Fī al-ḥaqīqe farqī malḥūẓ na va taghyīrī mashhūd na. Kullu dhālika min faḍli Allāh yuʾtīhi man yashāʾu min khalqihi. In shāʾ Allāh az arḍ-e nafy eḥterāz jūʾīm va be-baḥr-e ethbāt dar āʾīm tā ʿavālem-e jamʿ va farq va tawḥīd va tafrīq va taḥdīd va tajrīd-e ilāhī rā be-baṣarī ke moqaddas az ʿanāṣor va ażdād ast moshāhede konīm va be-aʿlā ofoq-e qorb va qods-e ḥażrat-e maʿānī parvāz namāʾīm.
:::

::: translation
Therefore, cleanse and sanctify your vision from outward limitations, so that you may see them all as having one name, one character, one essence, and one reality, and may also discern the mysteries of the return of the Words in the revealed Letters. Reflect a little on the companions in the age of the Point of the Furqan: how, through His holy breaths, they became purified, sanctified, and detached from every human concern and selfish desire; how, before all the people of the earth, they attained the honor of meeting Him, which was the very meeting with God, and detached themselves from all the people of the earth. You have heard how they sacrificed their lives before that glorious Manifestation. Now observe how that same steadfastness, firmness, and detachment have returned, in their very likeness, in the companions of the Point of the Bayan. You have seen how, through the wondrous bounty of the Lord of Lords, these companions raised the banner of detachment upon the heights of inaccessibility. In short, these lights have appeared from one lamp, and these fruits have grown from one tree. In truth, no difference can be discerned and no change observed. All this is from the grace of God, which He bestows on whomever He wills among His creatures. God willing, may we shun the land of negation and enter the ocean of affirmation, so that, with a vision sanctified from the elements and their opposites, we may behold the divine worlds of union and distinction, unity and differentiation, limitation and transcendence, and soar to the highest horizon of nearness to the Lord of inner meanings and His holiness.
:::

### 172

::: {.original lang="fa"}
پس از این بیانات معلوم شد که اگر در آخر لا آخر طلعتی بیاید و قیام نماید بر امری که قیام نمود بر آن طلعت اوّل لا اوّل هرآینه صدق طلعت اوّل بر طلعت آخر میشود زیرا که طلعت آخر لا آخر قیام نمود بهمان امر که طلعت اوّل لا اوّل بر آن قیام نمود اینست که نقطهٔ بیان روح ما سواه فداه شموس احدیّه را بشمس مثال زده‌اند که اگر از اوّل لا اوّل الی آخر لا آخر طلوع نماید همان شمس است که طالع میشود حال اگر گفته شود این شمس همان شمس اوّلیّه است صحیح است و اگر گفته شود که رجوع آن شمس است ایضاً صحیح است و همچنین از این بیان صادق میآید ذکر ختمیّت بر طلعت بدء و بالعکس زیرا که آنچه طلعت ختم بر آن قیام مینماید بعینه همان است که جمال بدء بر آن قیام فرموده
:::

::: transliteration
Pas az īn bayānāt maʿlūm shod ke agar dar ākher-e lā ākher ṭalʿatī biyāyad va qiyām namāyad bar amrī ke qiyām namūd bar ān ṭalʿat-e avval-e lā avval har-āyene ṣedq-e ṭalʿat-e avval bar ṭalʿat-e ākher mīshavad. Zīrā ke ṭalʿat-e ākher-e lā ākher qiyām namūd be-hamān amr ke ṭalʿat-e avval-e lā avval bar ān qiyām namūd. Īn ast ke noqṭe-ye bayān, rūḥ-e mā sevāh fedāh, shomūs-e aḥadiyye rā be-shams methāl zade-and ke agar az avval-e lā avval ilā ākher-e lā ākher ṭolūʿ namāyad hamān shams ast ke ṭāleʿ mīshavad. Ḥāl agar gofte shavad īn shams hamān shams-e avvaliyye ast ṣaḥīḥ ast va agar gofte shavad ke rojūʿ-e ān shams ast ayżan ṣaḥīḥ ast. Va hamchenīn az īn bayān ṣādeq mīāyad dhekr-e khatmiyyat bar ṭalʿat-e badʾ va be-l-ʿaks zīrā ke ānche ṭalʿat-e khatm bar ān qiyām mīnamāyad be-ʿeyne hamān ast ke jamāl-e badʾ bar ān qiyām farmūde.
:::

::: translation
These explanations make it clear that if, at the end that has no end, a Manifestation should come and arise to uphold the same Cause as the Manifestation at the beginning that has no beginning, the designation of the first Manifestation would assuredly apply to the last. For the Manifestation at the end that has no end has arisen to uphold the same Cause as the Manifestation at the beginning that has no beginning. Thus the Point of the Bayan—may the souls of all besides Him be sacrificed for Him—has likened the Suns of Oneness to the sun: even if it rises from the beginning that has no beginning until the end that has no end, it is the same sun that rises. Now, if it is said that this sun is that first sun, it is correct; and if it is said that it is the return of that sun, it is likewise correct. Similarly, this explanation shows that the designation of finality truly applies to the Manifestation of the beginning, and vice versa, for what the Manifestation of the end arises to uphold is precisely what the Beauty of the beginning arose to uphold.
:::

### 173

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و این مطلب با اینکه چه‌ قدر واضحست نزد شاربان صهبای علم و ایقان مع‌ذلک چه مقدار از نفوس که بسبب عدم بلوغ باین مطلب بذکر خاتم النّبیّین محتجب شده از جمیع فیوضات محجوب و ممنوع شده‌اند با اینکه خود آن حضرت فرمود امّا النّبیّون فأنا و همچنین فرمودند منم آدم و نوح و موسی و عیسی چنانچه ذکر شد مع‌ذلک تفکّر نمینمایند بعد از آنکه بر آن جمال ازلی صادق میآید باینکه فرمودند منم آدم اوّل همین قسم صادق میآید که بفرمایند منم آدم آخر و همچنان که بدء انبیا را که آدم باشد بخود نسبت دادند همین قسم ختم انبیا هم بآن جمال الهی نسبت داده میشود و این بسی واضحست که بعد از آنکه بدء النّبیّین بر آن حضرت صادقست همان قسم ختم النّبیّین صادق آید
:::

::: transliteration
Va īn maṭlab bā īnke che-qadr vāżeḥ ast nazd-e shārebān-e ṣahbā-ye ʿelm va īqān maʿa-dhālek che meqdār az nofūs ke be-sabab-e ʿadam-e bolūgh be-īn maṭlab be-dhekr-e khātam al-nabiyyīn moḥtajeb shode az jamīʿ-e foyūżāt maḥjūb va mamnūʿ shode-and. Bā īnke khod-e ān ḥażrat farmūd: ammā al-nabiyyūna fa-anā. Va hamchenīn farmūdand: manam Ādam va Nūḥ va Mūsā va ʿĪsā, chenānche dhekr shod. Maʿa-dhālek tafakkor nemīnamāyand. Baʿd az ānke bar ān jamāl-e azalī ṣādeq mīāyad be-īnke farmūdand manam Ādam-e avval, hamīn qesm ṣādeq mīāyad ke befarmāyand manam Ādam-e ākher. Va hamchenān ke badʾ-e anbiyā rā ke Ādam bāshad be-khod nesbat dādand hamīn qesm khatm-e anbiyā ham be-ān jamāl-e ilāhī nesbat dāde mīshavad. Va īn basī vāżeḥ ast ke baʿd az ānke badʾ al-nabiyyīn bar ān ḥażrat ṣādeq ast hamān qesm khatm al-nabiyyīn ṣādeq āyad.
:::

::: translation
Although this matter is so clear to those who drink the wine of knowledge and certitude, how many souls, through failing to grasp it, have nevertheless been veiled by the expression “Seal of the Prophets” and have been shut out and deprived of every outpouring of grace. Yet He Himself said, “As for the Prophets, I am they.” He also said, “I am Adam, Noah, Moses, and Jesus,” as already mentioned. Still they do not reflect. Since the words “I am the first Adam” truly apply to that eternal Beauty, it would be equally true for Him to say, “I am the last Adam.” And just as He attributed to Himself the beginning of the Prophets, who was Adam, so too the last of the Prophets is attributed to that divine Beauty. It is abundantly clear that, since the designation “beginning of the Prophets” truly applies to Him, the designation “last of the Prophets” likewise applies.
:::

### 174

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و باین مطلب جمیع اهل ارض در این ظهور ممتحن شده‌اند چنانچه اکثری بهمین قول تمسّک جسته از صاحب قول معرض شده‌اند و نمیدانم این قوم از اوّلیّت و آخریّت حقّ جلّ ذکره چه ادراک نموده‌اند اگر مقصود از اوّلیّت و آخریّت اوّلیّت و آخریّت ملکی باشد هنوز که اسباب ملکی بآخر نرسیده پس چگونه آخریّت بر آن ذات احدیّت صادق میآید بلکه در این رتبه اوّلیّت نفس آخریّت و آخریّت نفس اوّلیّت باشد
:::

::: transliteration
Va be-īn maṭlab jamīʿ-e ahl-e arḍ dar īn ẓohūr momtaḥan shode-and, chenānche aktharī be-hamīn qawl tamassok joste az ṣāḥeb-e qawl moʿreż shode-and. Va nemīdānam īn qawm az avvaliyyat va ākheriyyat-e Ḥaqq, jalla dhikruhu, che edrāk namūde-and. Agar maqṣūd az avvaliyyat va ākheriyyat avvaliyyat va ākheriyyat-e molkī bāshad hanūz ke asbāb-e molkī be-ākher narasīde, pas chegūne ākheriyyat bar ān dhāt-e aḥadiyyat ṣādeq mīāyad? Balke dar īn rotbe avvaliyyat nafs-e ākheriyyat va ākheriyyat nafs-e avvaliyyat bāshad.
:::

::: translation
All the people of the earth have been tested by this matter in this revelation, for most have clung to this very saying and turned away from the One who uttered it. I do not know what these people have understood by the firstness and lastness of God, exalted be His mention. If firstness and lastness mean firstness and lastness in the earthly world, the conditions of that world have not yet come to an end; how, then, can lastness truly apply to that Essence of Oneness? Rather, in this station, firstness is lastness itself, and lastness is firstness itself.
:::

### 175

::: {.original lang="fa"}
باری همان قسمی که در اوّل لا اوّل صدق آخریّت بر آن مربّی غیب و شهود میآید همان قسم هم بر مظاهر او صادق میآید و در حینی که اسم اوّلیّت صادقست همان حین اسم آخریّت صادق و در حینی که بر سریر بدئیّت جالسند همان حین بر عرش ختمیّت ساکن و اگر بصر حدید یافت شود مشاهده مینماید که مظهر اوّلیّت و آخریّت و ظاهریّت و باطنیّت و بدئیّت و ختمیّت این ذوات مقدّسه و ارواح مجرّده و انفس الهیّه هستند و اگر در هوای قدس کان اللّه و لم یکن معه من شیء طائر شوی جمیع این اسماء را در آن ساحت معدوم صرف و مفقود بحت بینی و دیگر هیچ باین حجبات و اشارات و کلمات محتجب نشوی چه لطیف و بلند است این مقام که جبرئیل بی‌دلیل سبیل نجوید و طیر قدسی بی‌اعانت غیبی طیران نتواند
:::

::: transliteration
Bārī hamān qesmī ke dar avval-e lā avval ṣedq-e ākheriyyat bar ān morabbī-ye gheyb va shohūd mīāyad hamān qesm ham bar maẓāher-e ū ṣādeq mīāyad. Va dar ḥīnī ke esm-e avvaliyyat ṣādeq ast hamān ḥīn esm-e ākheriyyat ṣādeq va dar ḥīnī ke bar sarīr-e badʾiyyat jālesand hamān ḥīn bar ʿarsh-e khatmiyyat sāken. Va agar baṣar-e ḥadīd yāft shavad moshāhede mīnamāyad ke maẓhar-e avvaliyyat va ākheriyyat va ẓāheriyyat va bāṭeniyyat va badʾiyyat va khatmiyyat īn dhavāt-e moqaddase va arvāḥ-e mojarrade va anfos-e ilāhiyye hastand. Va agar dar havā-ye qods-e kāna Allāhu wa-lam yakun maʿahu min shayʾ ṭāʾer shavī jamīʿ-e īn asmā rā dar ān sāḥat maʿdūm-e ṣerf va mafqūd-e baḥt bīnī va dīgar hīch be-īn ḥojobāt va eshārāt va kalemāt moḥtajeb nashavī. Che laṭīf va boland ast īn maqām ke Jebraʾīl bī-dalīl sabīl najūyad va ṭeyr-e qodsī bī-eʿānat-e gheybī ṭayarān natavānad.
:::

::: translation
In short, just as lastness truly applies, in the beginning that has no beginning, to the Nurturer of the unseen and the seen, so it also truly applies to His Manifestations. At the very moment when the name of firstness applies, the name of lastness also applies; and at the very moment when they sit upon the throne of beginning, they also dwell upon the throne of finality. If keen vision is attained, it will perceive that these sanctified Essences, these transcendent Spirits, and these divine Souls are the manifestations of firstness and lastness, outwardness and inwardness, beginning and finality. And if you soar in the holy atmosphere of “God was, and nothing whatsoever was with Him,” you will see all these names in that realm as sheer nonexistence and utter absence, and will no longer be veiled by these veils, allusions, and words. How subtle and exalted is this station, where Gabriel cannot find his way without a guide, and the holy bird cannot fly without unseen assistance!
:::

### 176

::: {.original lang="fa"}
حال قول حضرت امیر را ادراک نما که فرموده کشف سبحات الجلال من غیر اشارة و از جملهٔ سبحات مجلّله علمای عصر و فقهای زمان ظهورند که جمیع نظر بعدم ادراک و اشتغال و حبّ بریاست ظاهره تسلیم امر اللّه نمینمایند بلکه گوش نمیدهند تا نغمهٔ الهی را بشنوند بل یجعلون اصابعهم فی آذانهم و عباد هم چون ایشان را من دون اللّه ولیّ خود اخذ نموده‌اند منتظر رد و قبول این خشبهای مسنّده هستند زیرا از خود بصر و سمع و قلبی ندارند که تمیز و تفصیل دهند میانهٔ حقّ و باطل
:::

::: transliteration
Ḥāl qawl-e Ḥażrat-e Amīr rā edrāk namā ke farmūde: kashfu subuḥāti al-jalāli min ghayri ishāra. Va az jomle-ye soboḥāt-e mojallele ʿolamā-ye ʿaṣr va foqahā-ye zamān-e ẓohūrand ke jamīʿ naẓar be-ʿadam-e edrāk va eshteghāl va ḥobb be-riyāsat-e ẓāhere taslīm-e amr Allāh nemīnamāyand balke gūsh nemīdahand tā naghme-ye ilāhī rā beshnavand. Bal yajʿalūna aṣābiʿahum fī ādhānihim. Va ʿebād ham chon īshān rā min dūn Allāh valī-ye khod akhdh namūde-and montaẓer-e radd va qabūl-e īn khashabhā-ye mosannade hastand zīrā az khod baṣar va samʿ va qalbī nadārand ke tamīz va tafṣīl dehand miyāne-ye Ḥaqq va bāṭel.
:::

::: translation
Now grasp the saying of His Holiness the Commander: “Unveiling the splendors of glory without allusion.” Among these veiling splendors are the learned and the jurists of the age of revelation, who, through their lack of understanding, their preoccupations, and their love of outward leadership, all refuse to submit to the Cause of God. Indeed, they will not lend an ear to hear the divine melody. “Rather, they put their fingers in their ears.” Since the people have taken them as their guardians instead of God, they await the rejection or acceptance of these propped-up timbers, for they have no sight, hearing, or heart of their own with which to distinguish and discriminate between truth and falsehood.
:::

### 177

::: {.original lang="fa"}
با اینکه همهٔ انبیا و اصفیا و اولیا من عند اللّه امر فرمودند که بچشم و گوش خود بشنوند و ملاحظه نمایند مع‌ذلک معتنی بنصح انبیا نگشته تابع علمای خود بوده و خواهند بود و اگر مسکینی و یا فقیری که عاری از لباس اهل علم باشد بگوید یا قوم اتّبعوا المرسلین جواب گویند که این همه علما و فضلا با این ریاست ظاهره و البسهٔ مقطّعهٔ لطیفه نفهمیده‌اند و حقّ را از باطل ادراک ننموده‌اند و تو و امثال تو ادراک نموده‌اید و نهایت تعجّب مینمایند از چنین قولی با اینکه امم سلف اکثر و اعظم و اکبرند و اگر کثرت و لباس علم سبب و علّت علم و صدق باشد البتّه امم سابقه اولی و اسبقند
:::

::: transliteration
Bā īnke hame-ye anbiyā va aṣfiyā va awliyā min ʿindi Allāh amr farmūdand ke be-chashm va gūsh-e khod beshnavand va molāḥeẓe namāyand, maʿa-dhālek moʿtanī be-noṣḥ-e anbiyā nagashte tābeʿ-e ʿolamā-ye khod būde va khwāhand būd. Va agar meskīnī va yā faqīrī ke ʿārī az lebās-e ahl-e ʿelm bāshad begūyad, yā qawmi ittabiʿū al-mursalīn, javāb gūyand ke īn hame ʿolamā va fożalā bā īn reyāsat-e ẓāhere va albese-ye moqaṭṭaʿe-ye laṭīfe nafahmīde-and va Ḥaqq rā az bāṭel edrāk nanamūde-and va to va amthāl-e to edrāk namūde-īd, va nehāyat-e taʿajj ob mīnamāyand az chonīn qawlī. Bā īnke omam-e salaf akthar va aʿẓam va akbarand, va agar kathrat va lebās-e ʿelm sabab va ʿellat-e ʿelm va ṣedq bāshad, albatte omam-e sābeqe awlā va asbaqand.
:::

::: translation
Although all the Prophets, chosen ones, and holy ones commanded, on God's behalf, that people hear with their own ears and observe with their own eyes, they have nevertheless paid no heed to the Prophets' counsel, and have followed, and will continue to follow, their own religious scholars. If some humble or poor person, unadorned with the garb of learning, says, “My people, follow the Messengers,” they reply, “Have all these scholars and learned men, with their outward authority and finely tailored robes, failed to understand and to distinguish truth from falsehood, while you and your kind have understood?” They are utterly astonished at such a statement, even though the peoples of former times were more numerous, greater, and mightier. If numbers and the garb of learning were the grounds and causes of knowledge and truthfulness, the peoples of former times would certainly have the stronger and prior claim.
:::

### 178

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و با اینکه این فقره هم معلوم و واضحست که در جمیع احیان ظهور مظاهر قدسیّه علمای عهد مردم را از سبیل حقّ منع مینمودند چنانچه در جمیع کتب و صحف سماوی مذکور و مسطور است و احدی از انبیا مبعوث نشد مگر آنکه محلّ بغض و انکار و رد و سبّ علما گشت قاتلهم اللّه بما فعلوا من قبل و من بعد کانوا یفعلون حال کدام سبحات جلال اعظم از این هیاکل ضلالست واللّه کشف آن اعظم امور است و خرقش اکبر اعمال وفّقنا اللّه و ایّاکم یا معشر الرّوح لعلّکم بذلک فی زمن المستغاث توفّقون و من لقآء اللّه فی ایّامه لا تحتجبون
:::

::: transliteration
Va bā īnke īn feqre ham maʿlūm va vāżeḥ ast ke dar jamīʿ-e aḥyān-e ẓohūr-e maẓāher-e qodsiyye ʿolamā-ye ʿahd mardom rā az sabīl-e Ḥaqq manʿ mīnamūdand, chenānche dar jamīʿ-e kotob va ṣoḥof-e samāvī madhkūr va masṭūr ast. Va aḥadī az anbiyā mabʿūth nashod magar ānke maḥall-e boghż va enkār va radd va sabb-e ʿolamā gasht. Qātalahumu Allāhu bi-mā faʿalū min qablu wa-min baʿdu kānū yafʿalūn. Ḥāl kodām soboḥāt-e jalāl aʿẓam az īn hayākel-e żalāl ast? Wa-Allāh, kashf-e ān aʿẓam-e omūr ast va kharqash akbar-e aʿmāl. Waffaqanā Allāhu wa-iyyākum yā maʿshara al-rūḥ, laʿallakum bi-dhālika fī zamani al-Mustaghāth tuwaffaqūn wa-min liqāʾi Allāhi fī ayyāmihi lā taḥtajibūn.
:::

::: translation
It is also known and clear that whenever the holy Manifestations appeared, the religious scholars of the age kept people from the path of Truth, as is recorded and written in all the heavenly Books and Scriptures. Not a single Prophet was raised up without becoming the object of the scholars' hatred, denial, rejection, and abuse. May God confound them for what they did before and continued to do afterward! Now, what splendors of glory are greater than these embodiments of error? By God, unveiling them is the greatest of undertakings, and tearing through them the greatest of deeds. May God grant success to us and to you, O company of the Spirit, so that through this you may be aided in the time of the Mustaghāth and may not be veiled from meeting God in His days.
:::

### 179

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و همچنین ذکر خاتم النّبیّین و امثال آن از سبحات مجلّله است که کشف آن از اعظم امور است نزد این همج رعاع و جمیع باین حجبات محدوده و سبحات مجلّلهٔ عظیمه محتجب مانده‌اند آیا نغمهٔ طیر هویّه را نشنیده‌اند که میفرماید الف فاطمه نکاح نمودم که همه بنت محمّد بن عبداللّه خاتم النّبیّین بودند حال ملاحظه فرما که چه‌ قدر از اسرار در سرادق علم الهی مستور است و چه‌ مقدار جواهر علم او در خزائن عصمت مکنون تا یقین نمائی که صنع او را بدایت و نهایتی نبوده و نخواهد بود و فضای قضای او اعظم از آنست که ببیان تحدید شود و یا طیر افئده آن را طیّ نماید و تقدیرات قدریّهٔ او اکبر از آنست که بادراک نفسی منتهی شود خلق او از اوّل لا اوّل بوده و آخری او را اخذ نکرده و مظاهر جمال او الی نهایت لا نهایه خواهند بود و ابتدائی او را ندیده حال در همین بیان ملاحظه فرما که چگونه حکم آن بر جمیع این طلعات صدق مینماید
:::

::: transliteration
Va hamchenīn dhekr-e Khātam al-Nabiyyīn va amthāl-e ān az soboḥāt-e mojallale ast ke kashf-e ān az aʿẓam-e omūr ast nazd-e īn hamaj-e raʿāʿ, va jamīʿ be-īn ḥojobāt-e maḥdūde va soboḥāt-e mojallale-ye ʿaẓīme moḥtajeb mānde-and. Āyā naghme-ye ṭayr-e hoviyye rā nashenīde-and ke mīfarmāyad, alf Fāṭeme nekāḥ namūdam ke hame bent-e Moḥammad ebn-e ʿAbd Allāh Khātam al-Nabiyyīn būdand? Ḥāl molāḥeẓe farmā ke che qadr az asrār dar sorādeq-e ʿelm-e elāhī mastūr ast va che meqdār javāher-e ʿelm-e ū dar khazāʾen-e ʿeṣmat maknūn, tā yaqīn namāʾī ke ṣonʿ-e ū rā bedāyat va nehāyatī nabūde va nakhwāhad būd, va fażā-ye qażā-ye ū aʿẓam az ān ast ke be-bayān taḥdīd shavad va yā ṭayr-e afʾede ān rā ṭayy namāyad, va taqdīrāt-e qadariyye-ye ū akbar az ān ast ke be-edrāk-e nafsī montahī shavad. Khalq-e ū az avval-e lā avval būde va ākherī ū rā akhdh nakarde, va maẓāher-e jamāl-e ū ilā nehāyat-e lā nehāye khwāhand būd va ebtedāʾī ū rā nadīde. Ḥāl dar hamīn bayān molāḥeẓe farmā ke chegūne ḥokm-e ān bar jamīʿ-e īn ṭalaʿāt ṣedq mīnamāyad.
:::

::: translation
Likewise, the designation “Seal of the Prophets” and similar expressions are among the majestic splendors whose unveiling is one of the greatest undertakings in the eyes of this ignorant rabble. All have remained veiled by these limiting veils and these mighty, majestic splendors. Have they not heard the melody of the Bird of divine Being, who says, “I married a thousand Fāṭimihs, all of whom were daughters of Muḥammad son of ʿAbd Allāh, the Seal of the Prophets”? Now consider how many mysteries lie hidden in the tabernacle of divine knowledge, and how many jewels of His knowledge are concealed in the treasuries of infallibility, so that you may know with certainty that His creation has never had, and will never have, a beginning or an end. The expanse of His decree is too vast to be bounded by words or traversed by the bird of the heart, and His ordained decrees are too great to be encompassed by anyone's understanding. His creation has existed from a beginning that has no beginning, and no end has overtaken it; the Manifestations of His beauty will endure to an end that has no end, and no beginning has beheld them. Now reflect on this very utterance, and see how its meaning holds true of all these Countenances.
:::

### 180

::: {.original lang="ar"}
و همچنین نغمهٔ جمال ازلی حسین بن علی را ادراک نما که به سلمان میفرماید که مضمون آن اینست بودم با الف آدم که فاصلهٔ هر آدم به آدم بعد خمسین الف سنه بود و با هر یک ولایت پدرم را عرض نمودم و تفصیلی ذکر میفرماید تا آنکه میفرماید الف مرّه جهاد نمودم در سبیل الهی که اصغر و کوچکتر از همه مثل غزوهٔ خیبر بود که پدرم با کفّار محاربه و مجادله نمود حال اسرار ختم و رجع و لا اوّلیّت و لا آخریّت صنع همه را از این دو روایت ادراک فرما
:::

::: transliteration
Va hamchenīn naghme-ye Jamāl-e azalī Ḥosayn ebn-e ʿAlī rā edrāk namā ke be-Salmān mīfarmāyad ke mażmūn-e ān īn ast: būdam bā alf Ādam ke fāṣele-ye har Ādam be-Ādam-e baʿd khamsīn alf sana būd va bā har yek velāyat-e pedaram rā ʿarż namūdam. Va tafṣīlī dhekr mīfarmāyad tā ānke mīfarmāyad: alf marre jehād namūdam dar sabīl-e elāhī ke aṣghar va kūchektar az hame methl-e ghazve-ye Khaybar būd ke pedaram bā koffār moḥārebe va mojādele namūd. Ḥāl asrār-e khatm va rajʿ va lā avvaliyyat va lā ākheriyyat-e ṣonʿ hame rā az īn do revāyat edrāk farmā.
:::

::: translation
Likewise, grasp the melody of the eternal Beauty, Ḥusayn son of ʿAlī, who addresses Salmān in words whose meaning is this: “I was with a thousand Adams, and the interval between each Adam and the next was fifty thousand years. To each one I presented my father's authority.” He gives further details until He says, “A thousand times I fought in the path of God, and the least and smallest of them all was like the battle of Khaybar, when my father fought and contended with the unbelievers.” Now grasp from these two traditions all the mysteries of finality and return, and of creation's having neither beginning nor end.
:::

### 181

::: {.original lang="fa"}
باری ای حبیب من مقدّسست نغمهٔ لاهوت که باستماع و عقول ناسوت محدود شود نملهٔ وجود کجا تواند بعرصهٔ معبود قدم گذارد اگرچه نفوس ضعیفه از عدم ادراک این بیانات معضله را انکار نمایند و امثال این احادیث را نفی کنند بلی لا یعرف ذلک الّا اولو الألباب قل هو الختم الّذی لیس له ختم فی الابداع و لا بدء له فی الاختراع اذاً یا ملأ الارض فی ظهورات البدء تجلّیات الختم تشهدون
:::

::: transliteration
Bārī, ey ḥabīb-e man, moqaddas ast naghme-ye lāhūt ke be-estemāʿ va ʿoqūl-e nāsūt maḥdūd shavad. Namle-ye vojūd kojā tavānad be-ʿarṣe-ye Maʿbūd qadam godhārad? Agarche nofūs-e żaʿīfe az ʿadam-e edrāk īn bayānāt-e moʿżele rā enkār namāyand va amthāl-e īn aḥādīth rā nafy konand. Balī, lā yaʿrifu dhālika illā ulū al-albāb. Qul huwa al-khatmu alladhī laysa lahu khatmun fī al-ibdāʿ wa-lā badʾa lahu fī al-ikhtirāʿ. Idhan yā malaʾa al-arḍ fī ẓuhūrāti al-badʾ tajalliyāti al-khatm tashhadūn.
:::

::: translation
In short, my beloved, the melody of the divine realm is too exalted to be confined within the hearing and understanding of the human world. How can the ant of existence set foot in the court of the One who is worshipped? Yet feeble souls, through lack of understanding, deny these abstruse utterances and reject such traditions. Indeed, none understands this except those endowed with insight. Say: He is the End who has no end in creation and no beginning in origination. Thus, people of the earth, in the manifestations of the Beginning you witness the revelations of the End.
:::

### 182

::: {.original lang="fa"}
بسیار تعجّب است که این قوم در بعضی از مراتب که مطابق میل و هوای ایشان است متمسّک بآیهٔ منزلهٔ در فرقان و احادیث اولی الایقان میشوند و از بعضی که مغایر هوای ایشانست بالمرّه اعراض مینمایند قل أ تؤمنون ببعض الکتاب و تکفرون ببعض ما لکم کیف تحکمون ما لا تشعرون مثل آنکه در کتاب مبین ربّ العالمین بعد از ذکر ختمیّت فی قوله تعالی ولکنّه رسول اللّه و خاتم النّبیّین جمیع ناس را بلقای خود وعده فرموده چنانچه آیات مدلّهٔ بر لقای آن ملیک بقا در کتاب مذکور است و بعضی از قبل ذکر شده و خدای واحد شاهد مقال است که هیچ امری اعظم از لقا و اصرح از آن در فرقان ذکر نیافته فهنیئاً لمن فاز به فی یوم اعرض عنه اکثر النّاس کما انتم تشهدون
:::

::: transliteration
Besyār taʿajj ob ast ke īn qawm dar baʿżī az marāteb ke moṭābeq-e meyl va havā-ye īshān ast motamassek be-āye-ye monazzale dar Forqān va aḥādīth-e ūlī al-īqān mīshavand va az baʿżī ke moghāyer-e havā-ye īshān ast be-almarre eʿrāż mīnamāyand. Qul a-tuʾminūna bi-baʿḍi al-kitābi wa-takfurūna bi-baʿḍ? Mā lakum kayfa taḥkumūna mā lā tashʿurūn? Methl-e ānke dar Ketāb-e mobīn Rabb-e ʿālamīn baʿd az dhekr-e khātemiyyat fī qawlihi taʿālā, wa-lākinnahu rasūlu Allāhi wa-khātama al-nabiyyīn, jamīʿ-e nās rā be-leqā-ye khod vaʿde farmūde, chenānche āyāt-e modelle bar leqā-ye ān Malīk-e baqā dar Ketāb madhkūr ast va baʿżī az qabl dhekr shode. Va Khodā-ye vāḥed shāhed-e maqāl ast ke hīch amrī aʿẓam az leqā va aṣraḥ az ān dar Forqān dhekr nayāfte. Fa-hanīʾan li-man fāza bihi fī yawmin aʿraḍa ʿanhu aktharu al-nāsi kamā antum tashhadūn.
:::

::: translation
It is astonishing that, in matters that accord with their inclinations and desires, these people hold fast to the verse revealed in the Qurʾān and the traditions of those endowed with certitude, while utterly turning away from those that run counter to their desires. Say: Do you believe in part of the Book and disbelieve in part? What is wrong with you? How can you judge what you do not understand? For example, in the clear Book, after mentioning finality in His exalted words, “But he is the Messenger of God and the Seal of the Prophets,” the Lord of the worlds has promised all people a meeting with Himself. Thus, verses testifying to a meeting with that King of eternity are recorded in the Book, and some have already been cited. The one God bears witness to these words: nothing greater than this meeting, or more explicitly stated, has been mentioned in the Qurʾān. Blessed, then, is the one who attains it on a day when most people turn away from it, as you yourselves witness.
:::

### 183

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و مع‌ذلک بحکم اوّل از امر ثانی معرض گشته‌اند با اینکه حکم لقا در یوم قیام منصوص است در کتاب و قیامت هم بدلائل واضحه ثابت و محقّق شد که مقصود قیام مظهر اوست بر امر او و همچنین از لقا لقای جمال اوست در هیکل ظهور او اذ انّه لا تدرکه الأبصار و هو یدرک الأبصار و با جمیع این مطالب ثابته و بیانات واضحه من حیث لا یشعر بذکر ختم تمسّک جسته‌اند و از موجد ختم و بدء در یوم لقای او بالمرّه محتجب مانده‌اند و لو یؤاخذ اللّه النّاس بما کسبوا ما ترک علی ظهرها من دابّة ولکن یؤخّرهم الی اجل مسمّی و از همهٔ این مراتب چشم پوشیده اگر این قوم بقطره‌ئی از چشمهٔ لطیف یفعل ما یشآء و یحکم ما یرید میآشامیدند هیچ اینگونه اعتراضات غیر مرضیّه بر محلّ امر نمینمودند امر و قول و فعل در قبضهٔ قدرت اوست کلّ شیء فی قبضة قدرته اسیر و انّ ذلک علیه سهل یسیر فاعلست آنچه را اراده نماید و عامل است آنچه میل فرماید من قال لم و بم فقد کفر و اگر این عباد قدری بشعور بیایند از آنچه مرتکب شده‌اند هلاک میشوند و بدستهای خود خود را بنار که مقرّ و مرجع ایشانست راجع مینمایند آیا نشنیده‌اند که میفرماید لا یسأل عمّا یفعل و با این بیانات چگونه میتوان جسارت نمود و بزخارف قول مشغول شد
:::

::: transliteration
Va maʿa-dhālek be-ḥokm-e avval az amr-e thānī moʿreż gashte-and, bā īnke ḥokm-e leqā dar yawm-e qiyām manṣūṣ ast dar Ketāb, va qiyāmat ham be-dalāʾel-e vāżeḥe thābet va moḥaqqaq shod ke maqṣūd qiyām-e Maẓhar-e ūst bar amr-e ū, va hamchenīn az leqā leqā-ye jamāl-e ūst dar haykal-e ẓohūr-e ū, idh innahu lā tudrikuhu al-abṣāru wa-huwa yudriku al-abṣār. Va bā jamīʿ-e īn maṭāleb-e thābete va bayānāt-e vāżeḥe min ḥaythu lā yashʿur be-dhekr-e khatm tamassok joste-and va az Mūjed-e khatm va badʾ dar yawm-e leqā-ye ū be-almarre moḥtajeb mānde-and. Wa-law yuʾākhidhu Allāhu al-nāsa bi-mā kasabū mā taraka ʿalā ẓahrihā min dābbatin wa-lākin yuʾakhkhiruhum ilā ajalin musamman. Va az hame-ye īn marāteb chashm pūshīde, agar īn qawm be-qaṭreʾī az chashme-ye laṭīf-e yafʿalu mā yashāʾ wa-yaḥkumu mā yurīd mī-āshāmīdand, hīch īngūne eʿterāżāt-e gheyr-e marżiyye bar Maḥall-e amr namīnamūdand. Amr va qawl va feʿl dar qabże-ye qodrat-e ūst. Kullu shayʾin fī qabḍati qudratihi asīr, wa-inna dhālika ʿalayhi sahlun yasīr. Fāʿel ast ānche rā erāde namāyad va ʿāmel ast ānche meyl farmāyad. Man qāla lima wa-bima fa-qad kafar. Va agar īn ʿebād qadrī be-shoʿūr beyāyand, az ānche mortakeb shode-and halāk mīshavand va be-dasthā-ye khod khod rā be-nār ke maqarr va marjaʿ-e īshān ast rājeʿ mīnamāyand. Āyā nashenīde-and ke mīfarmāyad, lā yusʾalu ʿammā yafʿal? Va bā īn bayānāt chegūne mītavān jesārat namūd va be-zakhāref-e qawl mashghūl shod?
:::

::: translation
Nevertheless, on the strength of the first pronouncement, they have turned away from the second, although the promise of meeting on the Day of Resurrection is explicitly stated in the Book. It has also been clearly established and demonstrated that resurrection means the rising of His Manifestation to proclaim His Cause, and that meeting Him means meeting His Beauty in the person of His Manifestation, for “Eyes do not perceive Him, but He perceives the eyes.” Despite all these established truths and clear statements, they have unwittingly clung to the mention of finality and remained utterly veiled from the Originator of the end and the beginning on the day of meeting Him. “If God were to take people to task for what they have earned, He would leave no living creature on the earth's surface, but He gives them respite until an appointed time.” Leaving all these considerations aside, if these people drank but a drop from the gentle spring of “He does whatever He wills and decrees whatever He desires,” they would never raise such unseemly objections against the Seat of His Cause. Command, word, and deed lie within the grasp of His power. Everything is held captive in the grasp of His power, and that is easy and effortless for Him. He does whatever He wills and carries out whatever He desires. Whoever says “Why?” and “For what reason?” has indeed disbelieved. If these servants came to even a little awareness, they would perish at what they have committed and, with their own hands, consign themselves to the fire that is their abode and destination. Have they not heard Him say, “He is not questioned about what He does”? In the face of these statements, how can anyone presume to be so bold and indulge in specious words?
:::

### 184

::: {.original lang="fa"}
سبحان‌اللّه جهل و نادانی عباد بمقام و حدّی رسیده که بعلم و ارادهٔ خود مقبل شده از علم و ارادهٔ حقّ جلّ و عزّ معرض گشته‌اند
:::

::: transliteration
Sobḥān Allāh, jahl va nādānī-ye ʿebād be-maqām va ḥaddī resīde ke be-ʿelm va erāde-ye khod moqbel shode az ʿelm va erāde-ye Ḥaqq jalla wa-ʿazza moʿreż gashte-and.
:::

::: translation
Glory be to God! The ignorance and folly of these servants have reached such a degree that they have turned toward their own knowledge and will, and away from the knowledge and will of God, exalted and mighty is He.
:::

### 185

::: {.original lang="ar"}
حال انصاف دهید اگر این عباد موقن باین کلمات درّیّه و اشارات قدسیّه شوند و حقّ را یفعل ما یشآء بدانند دیگر چگونه باین مزخرفات تشبّث مینمایند و تمسّک میجویند بلکه آنچه بفرماید بجان اقرار نمایند و مذعن شوند قسم بخدا که اگر تقدیرات مقدّره و حکمتهای قدریّه سبقت نیافته بود ارض جمیع این عباد را معدوم مینمود ولکن یؤخّر ذلک الی میقات یوم معلوم
:::

::: transliteration
Ḥāl enṣāf dehīd, agar īn ʿebād mūqen be-īn kalemāt-e dorriyye va eshārāt-e qodsiyye shavand va Ḥaqq rā yafʿalu mā yashāʾ bedānand, dīgar chegūne be-īn mozakhrafāt tashabboth mīnamāyand va tamassok mījūyand? Balke ānche befarmāyad be-jān eqrār namāyand va modhʿen shavand. Qasam be-Khodā ke agar taqdīrāt-e moqaddare va ḥekmathā-ye qadariyye sabqat nayāfte būd, arż jamīʿ-e īn ʿebād rā maʿdūm mīnamūd. Wa-lākin yuʾakhkhiru dhālika ilā mīqāti yawmin maʿlūm.
:::

::: translation
Now judge fairly: if these servants became certain of these pearl-like words and holy allusions, and acknowledged that God “does whatever He wills,” how could they continue to cling to and rely upon such absurdities? Rather, they would wholeheartedly acknowledge and submit to whatever He said. I swear by God that, had the ordained decrees and the wisdom of providence not already been established, the earth would have annihilated all these servants. But He postpones this until the appointed hour of a known day.
:::

### 186

::: {.original lang="fa"}
باری هزار و دویست و هشتاد سنه از ظهور نقطهٔ فرقان گذشت و جمیع این همج رعاع در هر صباح تلاوت فرقان نموده‌اند و هنوز بحرفی از مقصود فائز نشدند و خود قرائت میکنند بعضی آیات را که صریح بر مطالب قدسیّه و مظاهر عزّ صمدیّه است مع‌ذلک هیچ ادراک ننموده‌اند و این مدّت این قدر ادراک نشده که مقصود از تلاوت کتب و قرائت صحف در هر عصری ادراک معانی آن و بلوغ بمعارج اسرار آن بوده والّا تلاوت بی‌معرفت را البتّه فائدهٔ کلّی نباشد
:::

::: transliteration
Bārī, hezār va devīst va hashtād sane az ẓohūr-e Noqṭe-ye Forqān godhasht va jamīʿ-e īn hamaj-e raʿāʿ dar har ṣabāḥ telāvat-e Forqān namūde-and va hanūz be-ḥarfī az maqṣūd fāʾez nashodand. Va khod qerāʾat mīkonand baʿżī āyāt rā ke ṣarīḥ bar maṭāleb-e qodsiyye va maẓāher-e ʿezz-e ṣamadiyye ast, maʿa-dhālek hīch edrāk nanamūde-and. Va īn moddat īn qadr edrāk nashode ke maqṣūd az telāvat-e kotob va qerāʾat-e ṣoḥof dar har ʿaṣrī edrāk-e maʿānī-ye ān va bolūgh be-maʿārej-e asrār-e ān būde, va-ellā telāvat-e bī-maʿrefat rā albatte fāʾede-ye kollī nabāshad.
:::

::: translation
In short, one thousand two hundred and eighty years have passed since the appearance of the Point of the Qurʾān, and all this ignorant rabble have recited the Qurʾān every morning, yet have not grasped a single letter of its purpose. They themselves read verses that explicitly concern holy truths and the Manifestations of everlasting glory, yet they have understood nothing. Throughout this time, they have not understood even this much: that the purpose of reciting the Books and reading the Scriptures in every age has been to comprehend their meanings and ascend to the heights of their mysteries. Otherwise, recitation without understanding can certainly yield no substantial benefit.
:::

### 187

::: {.original lang="fa"}
چنانچه شخصی در یومی نزد این فقیر بحر معانی حاضر بود و ذکری از علائم قیامت و حشر و نشر و حساب بمیان آمد و اصرار مینمود که حساب خلایق در ظهور بدیع چگونه شد که احدی اطّلاع نیافته بعد قدری از صور علمیّه و شئونات حکمیّه بقدر ادراک و فهم سامع القا شد و بعد ذکر شد که این مدّت مگر تلاوت فرقان ننموده‌ئی و آیهٔ مبارکه را که میفرماید فیومئذ لا یسأل عن ذنبه انس و لا جانّ را ندید‌ه‌اید و بمقصود ملتفت نشده‌اید که معنی سوٴال چنان نیست که ادراک نموده‌اید بلکه سوٴال بلسان و بیان نیست چنانچه همین آیه مشعر و مدلّ بر آنست و بعد میفرماید یعرف المجرمون بسیماهم فیؤخذ بالنّواصی و الأقدام
:::

::: transliteration
Chenānche shakhṣī dar yawmī nazd-e īn faqīr-e baḥr-e maʿānī ḥāżer būd va dhekrī az ʿalāʾem-e qiyāmat va ḥashr va nashr va ḥesāb be-meyān āmad va eṣrār mīnamūd ke ḥesāb-e khalāʾeq dar ẓohūr-e badīʿ chegūne shod ke aḥadī eṭṭelāʿ nayāfte. Baʿd qadrī az ṣovar-e ʿelmiyye va shoʾūnāt-e ḥekmiyye be-qadr-e edrāk va fahm-e sāmeʿ elqā shod va baʿd dhekr shod ke īn moddat magar telāvat-e Forqān nanamūdeʾī va āye-ye mobārake rā ke mīfarmāyad, fa-yawmaʾidhin lā yusʾalu ʿan dhanbihi insun wa-lā jānn, rā nadīde-īd? Va be-maqṣūd moltafet nashode-īd ke maʿnī-ye soʾāl chenān nīst ke edrāk namūde-īd, balke soʾāl be-lesān va bayān nīst, chenānche hamīn āye moshʿer va modell bar ān ast. Va baʿd mīfarmāyad, yuʿrafu al-mujrimūna bi-sīmāhum fa-yuʾkhadhu bi-al-nawāṣī wa-al-aqdām.
:::

::: translation
For example, one day someone was in the presence of this poor one, the Ocean of meanings, and the conversation turned to the signs of the Resurrection, the gathering, the raising of the dead, and the reckoning. He kept insisting, “How did the reckoning of all creatures take place in this wondrous Revelation without anyone knowing of it?” Some conceptions of knowledge and aspects of wisdom were then imparted to him according to his capacity to comprehend and understand. Afterward, he was asked, “Have you not been reciting the Qurʾān all this time? Have you not seen the blessed verse that says, ‘On that day neither human nor jinn will be questioned about his sin’?” You have failed to grasp its purpose: questioning does not mean what you have understood it to mean. Rather, this questioning is not conducted through speech and words, as this very verse indicates and attests. Then He says, “The guilty will be known by their countenances and seized by their forelocks and their feet.”
:::

### 188

::: {.original lang="fa"}
اینست که از وجهه حساب خلایق کشیده میشود و کفر و ایمان و عصیان جمیع ظاهر میگردد چنانچه الیوم مشهود است که بسیما اهل ضلالت از اصحاب هدایت معلوم و واضحند و اگر این عباد خالصاً للّه و طلباً لرضائه در آیات کتاب ملاحظه نمایند جمیع آنچه را که میطلبند البتّه ادراک مینمایند بقسمی که جمیع امور واقعه در این ظهور را از کلّی و جزئی در آیات او ظاهر و مکشوف ادراک مینمایند حتّی خروج مظاهر اسماء و صفات را از اوطان و اعراض و اغماض ملّت و دولت را و سکون و استقرار مظهر کلّیّه در ارض معلوم مخصوص ولکن لا یعرف ذلک الّا اولو الألباب
:::

::: transliteration
Īn ast ke az vajhe ḥesāb-e khalāʾeq kashīde mīshavad va kofr va īmān va ʿeṣyān-e jamīʿ ẓāher mīgardad, chenānche al-yawm mashhūd ast ke be-sīmā ahl-e żalālat az aṣḥāb-e hedāyat maʿlūm va vāżeḥand. Va agar īn ʿebād khāliṣan li-llāh va ṭalaban li-riḍāʾihi dar āyāt-e Ketāb molāḥeẓe namāyand, jamīʿ-e ānche rā ke mīṭalaband albatte edrāk mīnamāyand, be-qesmī ke jamīʿ-e omūr-e vāqeʿe dar īn ẓohūr rā az kollī va jozʾī dar āyāt-e ū ẓāher va makshūf edrāk mīnamāyand, ḥattā khorūj-e maẓāher-e asmā va ṣefāt rā az awṭān va eʿrāż va eghmāż-e mellat va dawlat rā va sokūn va esteqrār-e Maẓhar-e kolliyye dar arż-e maʿlūm-e makhṣūṣ. Wa-lākin lā yaʿrifu dhālika illā ulū al-albāb.
:::

::: translation
Thus it is by their countenances that all creatures are called to account, and everyone's unbelief, faith, and disobedience become apparent. So it is evident today that those in error are clearly distinguished by their countenances from the companions of guidance. If these servants were to ponder the verses of the Book solely for God's sake and in pursuit of His pleasure, they would certainly understand all that they seek. Indeed, they would perceive all the events of this Revelation, both great and small, plainly disclosed in His verses—even the departure of the manifestations of the names and attributes from their homelands, the rejection and disregard of people and government, and the dwelling and establishment of the universal Manifestation in a particular, designated land. But none understands this except those endowed with insight.
:::

### 189

::: {.original lang="ar"}
اختم القول بما نزّل علی محمّد من قبل لیکون ختامه المسک الّذی یهدی النّاس الی رضوان قدس منیر قال و قوله الحقّ و اللّه یدعو الی دارالسّلام و یهدی من یشآء الی صراط مستقیم لهم دارالسّلام عند ربّهم و هو ولیّهم بما کانوا یعملون لیسبق هذا الفضل علی العالم و الحمد للّه ربّ العالمین
:::

::: transliteration
Akhtimu al-qawla bi-mā nuzzila ʿalā Muḥammadin min qablu li-yakūna khitāmuhu al-miska alladhī yahdī al-nāsa ilā riḍwāni qudsin munīr. Qāla wa-qawluhu al-ḥaqq: wa-Allāhu yadʿū ilā dāri al-salāmi wa-yahdī man yashāʾu ilā ṣirāṭin mustaqīm. Lahum dāru al-salāmi ʿinda rabbihim wa-huwa waliyyuhum bi-mā kānū yaʿmalūn. Li-yasbiqa hādhā al-faḍlu ʿalā al-ʿālam, wa-al-ḥamdu li-llāhi rabbi al-ʿālamīn.
:::

::: translation
I conclude this discourse with what was sent down to Muḥammad before, so that its seal may be the musk that guides people to a radiant paradise of holiness. He said—and His word is truth—“God calls to the abode of peace and guides whomever He wills to a straight path.” “Theirs is the abode of peace with their Lord, and He is their protector because of what they have done.” Thus may this grace take precedence throughout the world. Praise be to God, the Lord of all worlds.
:::

### 190

::: {.original lang="fa"}
بیان را در هر مطلب مکرّر نمودیم که شاید هر نفسی از اعالی و ادانی از این بیانات بقدر و اندازهٔ خود قسمت و نصیب بردارد و اگر نفسی از ادراک بیانی عاجز باشد از بیان دیگر مقصود خود را ادراک نماید لیعلم کلّ اناس مشربهم
:::

::: transliteration
Bayān rā dar har maṭlab mokarrar namūdīm ke shāyad har nafsī az aʿālī va adānī az īn bayānāt be-qadr va andāze-ye khod qesmat va naṣīb bardārad va agar nafsī az edrāk-e bayānī ʿājez bāshad az bayān-e dīgar maqṣūd-e khod rā edrāk namāyad, li-yaʿlama kullu unāsin mashrabahum.
:::

::: translation
We have repeated the explanation of every subject so that perhaps every soul, whether high or low, may receive a share and portion of these explanations according to their own capacity and measure. If someone is unable to grasp one explanation, they may understand what they seek through another, “so that every people may know their drinking place.”
:::

### 191

::: {.original lang="fa"}
قسم بخدا که این حمامهٔ ترابی را غیر این نغمات نغمه‌هاست و جز این بیانات رموزها که هر نکته‌ئی از آن مقدّس است از آنچه بیان شد و از قلم جاری گشت تا مشیّت الهی چه وقت قرار گیرد که عروسهای معانی بی‌حجاب از قصر روحانی قدم ظهور بعرصهٔ قدم گذارند و ما من امر الّا بعد اذنه و ما من قدرة الّا بحوله و قوّته و ما من اله الّا هو له الخلق و الأمر و کلّ بأمره ینطقون و من اسرار الرّوح یتکلّمون
:::

::: transliteration
Qasam be-Khodā ke īn ḥamāme-ye torābī rā gheyr-e īn naghamāt naghmehāst va joz īn bayānāt romūzhā ke har nokteʾī az ān moqaddas ast az ānche bayān shod va az qalam jārī gasht tā mashiyyat-e elāhī che vaqt qarār gīrad ke ʿarūshā-ye maʿānī bī-ḥejāb az qaṣr-e rūḥānī qadam-e ẓohūr be-ʿarṣe-ye qedam goẕārand. Wa-mā min amrin illā baʿda idhnihi wa-mā min qudratin illā bi-ḥawlihi wa-quwwatihi wa-mā min ilāhin illā huwa lahu al-khalqu wa-al-amru wa-kullun bi-amrihi yanṭiqūna wa-min asrāri al-rūḥi yatakallamūn.
:::

::: translation
I swear by God that this earthly dove has melodies other than these songs, and mysteries beyond these explanations, every subtle point of which is sanctified beyond what has been explained and has flowed from the pen. It remains to be seen when the divine will shall decree that the brides of inner meanings step unveiled from their spiritual palace into the arena of eternity. Nothing comes to pass except with His permission, and there is no power except through His might and strength. There is no God but Him. His are creation and command, and all speak at His command and tell of the mysteries of the Spirit.
:::

### 192

::: {.original lang="fa"}
از قبل دو مقام از برای شموس مشرقه از مشارق الهیّه بیان نمودیم یکی مقام توحید و رتبهٔ تفرید چنانچه از قبل ذکر شد لا نفرّق بین احد منهم و مقام دیگر مقام تفصیل و عالم خلق و رتبهٔ حدودات بشریّه است در این مقام هر کدام را هیکلی معیّن و امری مقرّر و ظهوری مقدّر و حدودی مخصوص است چنانچه هر کدام باسمی موسوم و بوصفی موصوف و بامری بدیع و شرعی جدید مأمورند چنانچه میفرماید تلک الرّسل فضّلنا بعضهم علی بعض منهم من کلّم‌‌‌ اللّه ‌‌و رفع بعضهم درجات و آتینا عیسی بن مریم البیّنات و ایّدناه بروح القدس
:::

::: transliteration
Az qabl do maqām az barā-ye shomūs-e moshreqe az mashāreq-e elāhiyye bayān namūdīm: yekī maqām-e tawḥīd va rotbe-ye tafrīd, chenānche az qabl ẕekr shod, lā nufarriqu bayna aḥadin minhum; va maqām-e dīgar maqām-e tafṣīl va ʿālam-e khalq va rotbe-ye ḥodūdāt-e bashariyye ast. Dar īn maqām har kodām rā heykalī moʿayyan va amrī moqarrar va ẓohūrī moqaddar va ḥodūdī makhṣūṣ ast, chenānche har kodām be-esmī mawsūm va be-vaṣfī mawṣūf va be-amrī badīʿ va sharʿī jadīd maʾmūrand, chenānche mīfarmāyad: tilka al-rusulu faḍḍalnā baʿḍahum ʿalā baʿḍin minhum man kallama Allāhu wa-rafaʿa baʿḍahum darajātin wa-ātaynā ʿĪsā ibna Maryama al-bayyināti wa-ayyadnāhu bi-rūḥi al-qudus.
:::

::: translation
We previously explained two stations belonging to the suns that rise from the divine daysprings. One is the station of unity and the rank of oneness, as was mentioned before: “We make no distinction between any of them.” The other is the station of distinction, the world of creation, and the rank of human limitations. In this station, each has a particular form, an appointed cause, a predestined revelation, and specific limitations. Thus each bears a name, is characterized by an attribute, and is charged with a new cause and a new law. As He says: “These Messengers—We have favored some above others. Among them are those to whom God spoke, and some He raised in degree. We gave Jesus son of Mary clear proofs and strengthened Him with the Holy Spirit.”
:::

### 193

::: {.original lang="fa"}
نظر باختلاف این مراتب و مقاماتست که بیانات و کلمات مختلفه از آن ینابیع علوم سبحانی ظاهر میشود والّا فی‌الحقیقه نزد عارفین معضلات مسائل الهیّه جمیع در حکم یک کلمه مذکور است چون اکثر ناس اطّلاع بر مقامات مذکوره نیافته‌اند اینست که در کلمات مختلفهٔ آن هیاکل متّحده مضطرب و متزلزل میشوند
:::

::: transliteration
Naẓar be-ekhtelāf-e īn marāteb va maqāmāt ast ke bayānāt va kalemāt-e mokhtalefe az ān yanābīʿ-e ʿolūm-e sobḥānī ẓāher mīshavad va-ellā fī al-ḥaqīqe nazd-e ʿārefīn moʿḍalāt-e masāʾel-e elāhiyye jamīʿ dar ḥokm-e yek kaleme maẕkūr ast. Chon akthar-e nās eṭṭelāʿ bar maqāmāt-e maẕkūre nayāfte-and īn ast ke dar kalemāt-e mokhtalefe-ye ān hayākel-e mottaḥede moẓṭareb va motazalzel mīshavand.
:::

::: translation
It is because these ranks and stations differ that diverse utterances and words appear from those wellsprings of divine knowledge. Otherwise, in truth, to those who understand the intricacies of divine questions, they are all regarded as a single utterance. Since most people have not become acquainted with these stations, they are troubled and shaken by the differing words of those united Temples.
:::

### 194

::: {.original lang="fa"}
باری معلوم بوده و خواهد بود که جمیع این اختلافات کلمات از اختلافات مقاماتست اینست که در مقام توحید و علوّ تجرید اطلاق ربوبیّت و الوهیّت و احدیّت صرفه و هویّهٔ بحته بر آن جواهر وجود شده و میشود زیرا که جمیع بر عرش ظهور اللّه ساکنند و بر کرسیّ بطون ‌اللّه واقف یعنی ظهور اللّه بظهورشان ظاهر و جمال ‌اللّه از جمالشان باهر چنانچه نغمات ربوبیّه از این هیاکل احدیّه ظاهر شد
:::

::: transliteration
Bārī maʿlūm būde va khvāhad būd ke jamīʿ-e īn ekhtelāfāt-e kalemāt az ekhtelāfāt-e maqāmāt ast. Īn ast ke dar maqām-e tawḥīd va ʿolovv-e tajrīd eṭlāq-e robūbiyyat va olūhiyyat va aḥadiyyat-e ṣerfe va hoviyye-ye baḥte bar ān javāher-e vojūd shode va mīshavad zīrā ke jamīʿ bar ʿarsh-e ẓohūr-e Allāh sākenand va bar korsī-ye boṭūn-e Allāh vāqef, yaʿnī ẓohūr-e Allāh be-ẓohūrashān ẓāher va jamāl-e Allāh az jamālashān bāher, chenānche naghamāt-e robūbiyye az īn hayākel-e aḥadiyye ẓāher shod.
:::

::: translation
In short, it has been and will remain clear that all these differences in utterance arise from differences of station. Thus, in the station of unity and the heights of detachment, lordship, divinity, pure oneness, and unalloyed identity have been and are ascribed to those essences of existence. For they all dwell upon the throne of God's revelation and are established upon the seat of God's concealment. That is, God's revelation is manifested through their revelation, and God's beauty shines through their beauty. Thus the melodies of lordship have sounded from these Temples of oneness.
:::

### 195

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و در مقام ثانی که مقام تمیز و تفصیل و تحدید و اشارات و دلالات ملکیّه است عبودیّت صرفه و فقر بحت و فنای باتّ از ایشان ظاهر است چنانچه میفرماید انّی عبد اللّه و ما انا الّا بشر مثلکم
:::

::: transliteration
Va dar maqām-e thānī ke maqām-e tamyīz va tafṣīl va taḥdīd va eshārāt va dalālāt-e molkiyye ast ʿobūdiyyat-e ṣerfe va faqr-e baḥt va fanā-ye bātt az īshān ẓāher ast, chenānche mīfarmāyad: innī ʿabdu Allāh, va mā anā illā basharun mithlukum.
:::

::: translation
In the second station, which is the station of differentiation, distinction, limitation, and earthly signs and indications, pure servitude, utter poverty, and complete self-effacement are manifest in them. As He says: “I am the servant of God,” and “I am only a human being like you.”
:::

### 196

::: {.original lang="ar"}
و از این بیانات محقّقهٔ مثبته ادراک فرما مسائل خود را که سوٴال نموده بودی تا در دین الهی راسخ شوی و از اختلافات بیانات انبیا و اصفیا متزلزل نشوی
:::

::: transliteration
Va az īn bayānāt-e moḥaqqaqe-ye mothbete edrāk farmā masāʾel-e khod rā ke soʾāl namūde būdī tā dar dīn-e elāhī rāsekh shavī va az ekhtelāfāt-e bayānāt-e anbiyā va aṣfiyā motazalzel nashavī.
:::

::: translation
From these verified and substantiated explanations, understand the questions you had asked, so that you may become steadfast in the religion of God and not be shaken by differences in the utterances of the Prophets and chosen ones.
:::

### 197

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و اگر شنیده شود از مظاهر جامعه انّی انا اللّه حقّ است و ریبی در آن نیست چنانچه بکرّات مبرهن شد که بظهور و صفات و اسمای ایشان ظهور اللّه و اسم ‌اللّه و صفة ‌اللّه در ارض ظاهر اینست که میفرماید و ما رمیت اذ رمیت ولکنّ ‌اللّه رمی و همچنین انّ الّذین یبایعونک انّما یبایعون ‌اللّه و اگر نغمهٔ انّی رسول ‌اللّه برآرند این نیز صحیح است و شکّی در آن نه چنانچه میفرماید ما کان محمّد ابا احد من رجالکم ولکنّ رسول ‌اللّه و در این مقام همه مرسلند از نزد آن سلطان حقیقی و کینونة ازلی و اگر جمیع ندای انا خاتم النّبیّین برآرند آن هم حقّ است و شبهه را راهی نه و سبیلی نه زیرا که جمیع حکم یک ذات و یک نفس و یک روح و یک جسد و یک امر دارند و همه مظهر بدئیّت و ختمیّت و اوّلیّت و آخریّت و ظاهریّت و باطنیّت آن روح الأرواح حقیقی و ساذج السّواذج ازلیند و همچنین اگر بفرمایند نحن عباد اللّه این نیز ثابت و ظاهر است چنانچه بظاهر در منتها رتبهٔ عبودیّت ظاهر شده‌اند احدی را یارای آن نه که بآن نحو از عبودیّت در امکان ظاهر شود اینست که از آن جواهر وجود در مقام استغراق در بحار قدس صمدی و ارتقاء بمعارج معانی سلطان حقیقی اذکار ربوبیّه و الوهیّه ظاهر شد اگر درست ملاحظه شود در همین رتبه منتهای نیستی و فنا در خود مشاهده نموده‌اند در مقابل هستی مطلق و بقای صرف که گویا خود را معدوم صرف دانسته‌اند و ذکر خود را در آن ساحت شرک شمرده‌اند زیرا که مطلق ذکر در این مقام دلیل هستی و وجود است و این نزد واصلان بس خطا چه جای آنکه ذکر غیر شود و قلب و لسان و دل و جان بغیر ذکر جانان مشغول گردد و یا چشم غیر جمال او ملاحظه نماید و یا گوش غیر نغمهٔ او شنود و یا رجل در غیر سبیل او مشی نماید
:::

::: transliteration
Va agar shenīde shavad az maẓāher-e jāmeʿe innī anā Allāh, ḥaqq ast va raybī dar ān nīst, chenānche be-karrāt mobarhan shod ke be-ẓohūr va ṣefāt va asmā-ye īshān ẓohūr-e Allāh va esm-e Allāh va ṣefat-e Allāh dar arḍ ẓāher. Īn ast ke mīfarmāyad: wa-mā ramayta idh ramayta wa-lākinna Allāha ramā, va hamchenīn: inna alladhīna yubāyiʿūnaka innamā yubāyiʿūna Allāh. Va agar naghme-ye innī rasūlu Allāh barārand īn nīz ṣaḥīḥ ast va shakkī dar ān na, chenānche mīfarmāyad: mā kāna Muḥammadun abā aḥadin min rijālikum wa-lākin rasūla Allāh. Va dar īn maqām hame morsaland az nazd-e ān solṭān-e ḥaqīqī va kaynūnat-e azalī. Va agar jamīʿ nedā-ye anā khātamu al-nabiyyīn barārand ān ham ḥaqq ast va shobhe rā rāhī na va sabīlī na zīrā ke jamīʿ ḥokm-e yek ẕāt va yek nafs va yek rūḥ va yek jasad va yek amr dārand va hame maẓhar-e badʾiyyat va khatmiyyat va avvaliyyat va ākhiriyyat va ẓāhiriyyat va bāṭiniyyat-e ān rūḥ al-arvāḥ-e ḥaqīqī va sāẕaj al-savāẕaj-e azalī-and. Va hamchenīn agar befarmāyand naḥnu ʿibādu Allāh īn nīz thābet va ẓāher ast chenānche be-ẓāher dar montahā rotbe-ye ʿobūdiyyat ẓāher shode-and aḥadī rā yārā-ye ān na ke be-ān naḥv az ʿobūdiyyat dar emkān ẓāher shavad. Īn ast ke az ān javāher-e vojūd dar maqām-e esteghrāq dar beḥār-e qods-e ṣamadī va erteqā be-maʿārej-e maʿānī-ye solṭān-e ḥaqīqī aẕkār-e robūbiyye va olūhiyye ẓāher shod. Agar dorost molāḥaẓe shavad dar hamīn rotbe montahā-ye nīstī va fanā dar khod moshāhede namūde-and dar moqābel-e hastī-ye moṭlaq va baqā-ye ṣerf ke gūyā khod rā maʿdūm-e ṣerf dāneste-and va ẕekr-e khod rā dar ān sāḥat sherk shemorde-and zīrā ke moṭlaq-e ẕekr dar īn maqām dalīl-e hastī va vojūd ast va īn nazd-e vāṣelān bas khaṭā che jā-ye ānke ẕekr-e gheyr shavad va qalb va lesān va del va jān be-gheyr-e ẕekr-e jānān mashghūl gardad va yā chashm gheyr-e jamāl-e ū molāḥaẓe namāyad va yā gūsh gheyr-e naghme-ye ū shenavad va yā rejl dar gheyr-e sabīl-e ū mashy namāyad.
:::

::: translation
If the all-embracing Manifestations are heard to say, “I am God,” it is true, and there is no doubt in it. For it has repeatedly been demonstrated that through their revelation, attributes, and names, the revelation of God, the name of God, and the attribute of God are manifested on earth. Thus He says: “It was not you who threw when you threw, but God who threw,” and likewise: “Those who pledge allegiance to you are only pledging allegiance to God.” If they raise the song, “I am the Messenger of God,” this too is correct and beyond doubt. As He says: “Muḥammad is not the father of any of your men, but the Messenger of God.” In this station, they are all sent by that true Sovereign and eternal Being. If they all proclaim, “I am the Seal of the Prophets,” that too is true, and doubt has no way or access to it, for they are all regarded as one essence, one self, one spirit, one body, and one cause. They all manifest the beginning and the end, the firstness and the lastness, the outwardness and the inwardness of that true Spirit of spirits and eternal Essence of essences. Likewise, if they say, “We are the servants of God,” this too is established and manifest, for outwardly they have appeared in the utmost degree of servitude. No one in the contingent world has the capacity to manifest such servitude. Thus, while immersed in the oceans of eternal holiness and ascending the heights of the inner meanings of the true Sovereign, those essences of existence have voiced declarations of lordship and divinity. If this is considered carefully, in this very rank they have perceived in themselves the utmost nothingness and self-effacement before absolute existence and pure permanence, as though they regarded themselves as utter nonexistence and considered any mention of themselves in that court to be the association of partners with God. For in this station, any mention at all is evidence of being and existence, and to those who have attained, this is a grave error. How much more so if anyone else were mentioned, and heart and tongue, soul and spirit were occupied with anything other than remembrance of the Beloved, or if the eye beheld anything but His beauty, the ear heard anything but His melody, or the foot walked in any path but His.
:::

### 198

::: {.original lang="ar"}
در این زمان نسمة اللّه وزیده و روح ‌اللّه احاطه نموده قلم از حرکت ممنوع و لسان از بیان مقطوع گشته
:::

::: transliteration
Dar īn zamān nasamat Allāh vazīde va rūḥ Allāh eḥāṭe namūde qalam az ḥarekat mamnūʿ va lesān az bayān maqṭūʿ gashte.
:::

::: translation
At this moment the breeze of God has blown and the Spirit of God has encompassed all. The pen has been restrained from moving, and the tongue has been stopped from speaking.
:::

### 199

::: {.original lang="fa"}
باری نظر باین مقام ذکر ربوبیّه و امثال ذلک از ایشان ظاهر شده و در مقام رسالت اظهار رسالت فرمودند و همچنین در هر مقام باقتضای آن ذکری فرمودند و همه را نسبت بخود داده‌اند از عالم امر الی عالم خلق و از عوالم ربوبیّه الی عوالم ملکیّه اینست که آنچه بفرمایند و هر چه ذکر نمایند از الوهیّت و ربوبیّت و نبوّت و رسالت و ولایت و امامت و عبودیّت همه حقّست و شبهه در آن نیست پس باید تفکّر در این بیانات که استدلال شده نمود تا دیگر از اختلافات اقوال مظاهر غیبیّه و مطالع قدسیّه احدی را اضطراب و تزلزل دست ندهد
:::

::: transliteration
Bārī naẓar be-īn maqām ẕekr-e robūbiyye va amthāl-e ẕālek az īshān ẓāher shode va dar maqām-e resālat eẓhār-e resālat farmūdand va hamchenīn dar har maqām be-eqteżā-ye ān ẕekrī farmūdand va hame rā nesbat be-khod dāde-and az ʿālam-e amr elā ʿālam-e khalq va az ʿavālem-e robūbiyye elā ʿavālem-e molkiyye. Īn ast ke ānche befarmāyand va har che ẕekr namāyand az olūhiyyat va robūbiyyat va nobovvat va resālat va velāyat va emāmat va ʿobūdiyyat hame ḥaqq ast va shobhe dar ān nīst. Pas bāyad tafakkor dar īn bayānāt ke estedlāl shode namūd tā dīgar az ekhtelāfāt-e aqvāl-e maẓāher-e gheybiyye va maṭāleʿ-e qodsiyye aḥadī rā eżṭerāb va tazalzol dast nadahad.
:::

::: translation
In short, it is with reference to this station that declarations of lordship and the like have issued from them, while in the station of messengership they have declared their messengership. Likewise, in every station they have spoken as that station required and have ascribed all these things to themselves, from the world of command to the world of creation, and from the realms of lordship to the earthly realms. Thus, whatever they say and whatever they declare concerning divinity, lordship, prophethood, messengership, guardianship, leadership, and servitude is all true and beyond doubt. One must therefore reflect on these explanations that have been offered as proof, so that differences in the sayings of the Manifestations of the unseen and the Daysprings of holiness may no longer cause anyone distress or uncertainty.
:::

### 200

::: {.original lang="fa"}
باری در کلمات شموس حقیقت باید تفکّر نمود و اگر ادراک نشد باید از واقفین مخازن علم سوٴال شود تا بیان فرمایند و رفع اشکال نمایند نه آنکه بعقل ناقص خود کلمات قدسیّه را تفسیر نمایند و چون مطابق نفس و هوای خود نیابند بنای رد و اعتراض گذارند چنانچه الیوم علما و فقهای عصر که بر مسند علم و فضل نشسته‌اند و جهل را علم نام گذاشته‌اند و ظلم را عدل نامیده‌اند اگر مجعولات خاطر خود را از شمس حقیقی سوٴال نمایند و جواب موافق آنچه فهمیده و یا از کتاب مثل خود ادراک نموده‌اند نشنوند البتّه نفی علم از آن معدن و منبع علم نمایند چنانچه در هر زمانی این واقع شد
:::

::: transliteration
Bārī dar kalemāt-e shomūs-e ḥaqīqat bāyad tafakkor namūd va agar edrāk nashod bāyad az vāqefīn-e makhāzen-e ʿelm soʾāl shavad tā bayān farmāyand va rafʿ-e eshkāl namāyand na ānke be-ʿaql-e nāqeṣ-e khod kalemāt-e qodsiyye rā tafsīr namāyand va chon moṭābeq-e nafs va havā-ye khod nayāband banā-ye radd va eʿterāż goẕārand. Chenānche al-yawm ʿolamā va foqahā-ye ʿaṣr ke bar masnad-e ʿelm va fażl nesheste-and va jahl rā ʿelm nām goẕāshte-and va ẓolm rā ʿadl nāmīde-and agar majʿūlāt-e khāṭer-e khod rā az shams-e ḥaqīqī soʾāl namāyand va javāb movāfeq-e ānche fahmīde va yā az ketāb-e methl-e khod edrāk namūde-and nashnavand al-batte nafī-ye ʿelm az ān maʿdan va manbaʿ-e ʿelm namāyand chenānche dar har zamānī īn vāqeʿ shod.
:::

::: translation
In short, one must reflect on the words of the Suns of Truth. If they are not understood, one must ask those acquainted with the treasuries of knowledge to explain them and resolve the difficulty, rather than interpret the sacred words through one's own deficient reason and, on finding them contrary to one's own desires and inclinations, proceed to reject and challenge them. Thus today, the scholars and jurists of the age, who occupy the seats of learning and excellence, who have named ignorance knowledge and called oppression justice, may question the true Sun about the fabrications of their own minds. If they do not hear an answer that agrees with what they have understood or gathered from the books of others like themselves, they will certainly deny knowledge to that mine and source of knowledge, as has happened in every age.
:::

### 201

::: {.original lang="fa"}
مثل اینکه مذکور شد در سوٴال از اهلّه که از سیّد وجود نمودند و آن حضرت بامر الهی جواب فرمود که هی مواقیت للنّاس بعد از استماع نفی علم از آن حضرت نمودند
:::

::: transliteration
Methl-e īnke maẕkūr shod dar soʾāl az ahelle ke az sayyed-e vojūd namūdand va ān ḥażrat be-amr-e elāhī javāb farmūd ke hiya mawāqītu li-l-nās, baʿd az estemāʿ nafī-ye ʿelm az ān ḥażrat namūdand.
:::

::: translation
